Images2/3/4 provide identity/direction/style evidence only; do not reinterpret or recompose from them. Follow the precise correction below and preserve everything else. Keep entire body, FIVE cards, hand grips, face, hair, knee positions, all clothing, physical head size and EXACT canvas position unchanged. Travel is SOUTHWEST toward bottomLEFT. The lifted REAR shoe at screenRIGHT currently points outward bottomRIGHT: rotate ONLY this ankle and shoe inward so its heel-to-toe long axis points bottomLEFT like the FRONT shoe and travel. The TOE must be to screenLEFT of its HEEL, never to screenRIGHT. Show the correct heel and shoe side plane with the same red/gold ornaments. Rear shoe stays lifted in its same approximate location; preserve bent knee and anatomical leg connection. Front shoe already points bottomLEFT; do not change it. This correction is shoe orientation, not leg spacing or body rotation. No zoom, no global enlargement, no canvas crop, no new limb/shoe.
